entries.name: RuneSteel Ingot
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: native 36x36 pixel fantasy MMORPG inventory material icon, enlarged as the supplied reference. Edit target: attached stock Platinum ingot icon. Primary request: recolor only this SAME stock icon to make the RuneSteel Ingot tier variant. Color palette: deep emerald green and dark forest green, crisp pale mint glint; deep emerald is dominant. Invariants: preserve the exact silhouette, two overlapping chunky beveled ingot shapes, diagonal orientation, framing, scale, dark navy nearly-black square backdrop, pixelated 36x36 style, shadow placement, and all large highlight shapes of the reference. Keep every shape in the same location and the object occupying the same canvas area. It must look like a color variant from the very same original client sprite sheet. Do not redesign into a crystal, orb, bottle, rune-covered long bar, chest, armor or bag. Do not add fine detail, runes, text, borders, particles, extra objects or scenery. Do not smooth into high-resolution painting; preserve the chunky low resolution grid. This is a pixel-art palette swap only. One square icon.
